summary: 12 months of recurring free credits for accepted early-stage startups, from bootstrapped/pre-seed through Series A, building a voice/audio product in production or launching within six months. Exact credit amount is unpublished. Credits cover core voice AI infrastructure, including Speech-to-text, Streaming speech-to-text and Dictation. Discounted startup pricing does not apply to LLM Gateway. Main program guidance says review within one week, with partner-portfolio fast-track decisions in 48 hours; the application page separately says 2–3 business days. Credits land within 48 hours of approval.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: bootstrapped/pre-seed through Series A, building with voice/audio, in production or launching within six months.
Complete the startup-program application with company, product, stage, and usage details.
Wait for application review. Main program guidance says within one week and 48 hours for partner fast-track; the application page separately says 2–3 business days, so confirm timing.
If approved, receive credits in the AssemblyAI console within 48 hours.
Use credits on approved core voice AI infrastructure; do not expect the startup pricing discount on LLM Gateway.
